lines.en: Will things really go back to normal after this?
lines.zh: 这事之后，一切真的会恢复正常吗？
不可能的……对吧？

lines.en: The look in Ayane’s eyes the moment she was caught-
lines.zh: 被抓到的那一刻，Ayane 眼里的神情——

lines.en: It’s like every exhibitionist joke she ever made was killed right then and there.
lines.zh: 她曾经开过的每一个关于暴露的玩笑，仿佛就在那一刻全被杀死了。

lines.en: Every ounce of joy in her faded away.
lines.zh: 她心里每一丝喜悦都消散了。

lines.en: And she was left with nothing but what I had inside of her.
lines.zh: 她什么也没剩下，只剩我留在她体内的东西。

lines.en: I think I need to take a nap.
lines.zh: 我想我得睡个午觉。
{i}Ayane 的欲望提升到了 [ayane_lust]！{/i}
